verdicts.reason: A keeps the turbine and headline as a proper lockup, but it is jammed against the left side, touching the top and bottom edges. The green and blue triangles float mid-canvas as random fragments instead of anchoring the corners, so the right two-thirds feel arbitrary and the layout is lopsided. B shrinks the turbine, the key image, to a tiny icon jammed into a cluttered bottom strip with the red and blue shapes and line fragments. A long diagonal line slices across the left, and the green shape sits awkwardly above the headline, so the imagery becomes trivial and the composition looks broken.
